stem.text: A cell of negligible internal resistance is connected to resistors $R_1$, $R_2$ and $R_3$, as shown. The cell provides power to the circuit and power is dissipated in the resistors.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram with a cell at the top and three resistors labelled R1, R2 and R3.

A.text: power loss in $R_1$ = power loss in $R_2$ + power loss in $R_3$

B.text: power loss in $R_2$ = power loss in $R_3$

C.text: power output of cell = power loss in $R_1$ + power loss in $R_2$ + power loss in $R_3$

D.text: power output of cell = power loss in $R_1$
